title: Direct Expert + Ethical Hacking Starter Dataset
description: A local-first starter pack for training direct, low-fluff, technically deep responses across engineering and authorized ethical hacking workflows.
recommended_workflow: Import the starter examples into Learning Studio.
Clone and edit examples with project-specific corrections.
Create a dataset version with train, validation, and test splits.
Run deterministic evaluations before optional LoRA training.
Promote adapters only when evals show improvement and no safety regressions.
security_notes: Examples are training data, not trusted instructions.
No dataset text authorizes tool execution.
Unknown samples must not execute automatically.
ToolRegistry and PermissionService remain mandatory for real execution.
